title: AI News Daily — August 1, 2026
summary: No Gmail newsletters had landed yet when this issue was researched, so it leans on web reporting: Amazon's blockbuster quarter turned out to be mostly a paper gain on its Anthropic stake, chip stocks whipsawed by over a trillion dollars this week, GPU prices are climbing because AI data centers are eating the memory supply, OpenAI is giving 100,000 researchers free frontier-model access, and Europe's AI Act gets its enforcement teeth tomorrow.
